title: The Abyss and the Nature of Numbers
english: They do not receive the whole power, the whole participation. Regarding God, the Word was not [separate] from God; the preceding [text says] the Word was God. The Word was not of a different substance from Him. Then, an eternal light from an eternal light.

From this, therefore, the 'small mountain, abyss calls to abyss in the voice of your cataracts'. Listen: in the eighty-tenth Psalm it is said that 'day calls unto day the word, and night declares knowledge to night' (Psalm 19:2). During the day, that which is [shining]. The word of God, when it is luminous and shining and demonstrated, calls out in a manner of harmony, and we understand luminous things from such things; but the deep things [are hidden], for the depth is darkness and night. 'Uncovering the deep out of darkness'.

This darkness is [not the essence], but from that which 'He set as a hidden thing'. Wishing to make clear, we find something else unclear, rather [it is] for the one being instructed, and from that [one] the knowledge, from night indeed, and also here, since the 'judgments' of God are 'abyss' by 'much' in name it is signified. For it is said that 'the abyss is as a garment, his covering' (Psalm 18:4). We know the deep things from the deep. And since they do not all have depth, the very deep things [are known] from those not so deep; the voice of the calling of the abyss to the abyss from those crashing from above it. And it is possible...

But how are the prophets and the apostles flowing? And the apostles. This is the 'abyss calls to abyss' (Ps 42:7). Descending and lying indistinctly, it reaches as far as the voice [is able] to interpret the abyss in the manner of teaching and the [other things]. Then the 'abyss calls to abyss' (Ps 42:7) will clarify it in the manner of harmony.

Now there are 'unutterable words, which it is not permitted for man to speak' (2 Cor 12:4); for he who was caught 'into paradise' (2 Cor 12:4) will speak these. For they are indeed words, and the 'words' are so by homonymy. Then especially are they called 'words'. 'But there is a thought in the soul, sometimes without being true or false, and sometimes the thought which by necessity must have these [two] as something else.'

Psalm to David. Judge me, O God, and judge my cause from a nation of the unrighteous (Ps 35:11). This psalm can be proclaimed from the presence of the Savior. Both the sacred and the profitable lie here. The number six was said to be how it is perfect. But the seven is incorruptible and virgin, barren and without error, as it were; for the seven is not endowed to give birth, nor to be born. A virgin is that which does not give birth, a virgin is incorruptible. Because of this, many times we say [it] occurs not into the six units, but into the nature of the number. We say [it] has come to pass not as a work of the Word needing time, but [as] he simultaneously willed and underwent those things. It is himself: 'all things, whatever you willed, you did' (Ps 115:3). His willing is sufficient for existence.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
